How to use Unifile

Four taps from the file you have to the file you need. The sample buttons above let you practise for free.

  1. Drop your file

    Drag it onto the box, tap the box to browse, or paste a copied image. Add as many files as you like.

    holiday.heic

  2. Pick a format

    Unifile only shows formats your file can really become. Tap the one you want.

    PNGJPGPDFWEBP

  3. Press Convert

    Photos and documents take seconds. Videos convert at normal playing speed, so keep the tab open.

  4. Download it

    Save your new file. Need another format? Pick it and convert again.

    Download photo.jpg
Many files at once

Drop a batch, press Convert all, then Download all as one ZIP. Type a name to rename them in order, like receipts-01, receipts-02.

Questions

Are my files uploaded anywhere?

No. Unifile does the conversion inside your browser, on your own device. Your files are never sent to a server, which is also why it works so quickly for photos and documents.

Does it work without internet?

Yes. Once this page has loaded, you can switch off Wi-Fi and keep converting. Nothing is sent anywhere, which you can check with the upload counter at the top or your browser's network tools.

Does it remove location data from my photos?

Yes. Every photo Unifile saves is a fresh copy without the hidden camera data, including GPS location. Use Remove photo location to clean a photo without changing its format.

Why can't I select text after shrinking a PDF?

To get large PDFs and scans under a size limit, Unifile saves each page as a compressed picture. It looks the same, but the text can't be selected or searched afterwards. Keep your original for editing.

What if a conversion fails?

Your original file is never changed. Check that it opens normally, then try again or pick another format.

Why is video slower than everything else?

Videos are re-recorded at normal playing speed on your device, so a 1-minute clip takes about 1 minute. Keep the tab open and in front while it runs. GIFs and still frames are much faster.

Will my Word or PowerPoint layout look identical?

Unifile keeps the words, headings, bullet points and tables, and lays them out cleanly. Custom fonts, pictures inside documents and slide designs are not copied across. PDF exports use standard Latin fonts, so languages like Chinese or Arabic are best exported to Word, HTML or TXT.

Is it really free? Is there a subscription?

Yes, it's free. Every conversion is unlimited, with no account, no subscription and nothing to pay.

What is Unifile Pro?

An optional one-off A$15 unlock that adds one-click batch to ZIP, saved presets, a dark/light theme switch and hides the tip message. Nothing free is taken away. Checking a Pro licence key sends only the key to Lemon Squeezy, our payment provider; your files still never leave your device.
